source: Nightlife Culture Style Guide v1.0, August 2026
note: Global rules that apply to every artefact. A validator enforces these; prose does not.

pink.role: hot counter-signal, accent bars, pull-quote rules

teal.role: cool highlight, section headers on dark grounds

laws: Every accent is a black-text surface. Every ground is a white-text surface.
Accents never encode data. Only the chart ramp encodes data.
Accents are blocks, never full-bleed slide grounds.
Teal is the kicker colour on every dark ground. Never butter on ink.
Titles on light grounds are charcoal, not blue. Blue is for the sub.

composition.anchorNote: Every .pad declares data-anchor, and the value comes from the layout contract — never from the author's judgement. 'two' pins the last block to the bottom so the composition spans the frame (the default for content slides). 'centre' optically centres a single block (dividers, quotes). 'top' is permitted ONLY for layouts whose contract declares it — those whose content block is tall enough to fill the frame on its own, such as the two-column contrast. Implicit top-anchoring is what leaves a dead band at the bottom of a slide; this is why the anchor is a contract field and not a styling decision.
composition.blockNote: A block is any direct child of .pad. Kicker, title, breaker, sub, column group, chart, stat row each count as one.

forbidColour.teal: 1.52:1 on white — never a logo colour on a light ground
